title: QCommE2E: An Open-Source Simulation of End-to-End Quantum Communication Systems
summary: This paper presents QCommE2E as an open-source simulation framework for end-to-end quantum communication systems, with explicit tutorial emphasis. The primary objective is to develop a comprehensive framework that includes transmitters, receivers, communication channels, performance metrics, and visualization tools, to facilitate the systematic design, configuration, and analysis of experimental simulations for novel quantum communication architectures.
